presidential_approval._note: Computed live from potus-approval.csv by environment.py — this block is a fallback only and is overridden at runtime.
presidential_approval.source: potus-approval.csv weighted average (1069 polls in file, 881 inside the 540-day window, half-life 21d, through 10/18/26)

economy.gdp_source: BEA Q2 2026 second estimate (released 8/26/26): +1.5% annualized, unchanged from the advance estimate, with consumer spending revised up to 3.4%. Down from Q1 2026's +2.1% third estimate. Q2 third estimate due late September 2026; the Q3 advance estimate in late October is the last GDP print before the election.
economy.consumer_sentiment_source: University of Michigan, October 2026 preliminary: 48.0, essentially flat from September's 48.1 and down from August's 51.7 and July's 55.2. Taken from the Surveys of Consumers monthly series (sca.isr.umich.edu/files/tbmics.csv), pulled 10/26/26 and saved as tbmics.csv. The October final is due ~Oct 30, the last sentiment release before the election.
economy.unemployment_source: BLS Employment Situation, July 2026 (released 8/7/26). U-3 fell to 4.1% from 4.2%, but for a weak reason — payrolls fell 23k, May and June were revised down 103k combined, and the participation rate dropped to 61.4%. STALE AS OF 2026-10-19: the August and September Employment Situation reports are not reflected here. Note: unemployment is carried for display only; national_environment_shift() does not read it, so this does not affect the forecast.
